method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text, seat-neutral core with regulative rules where the text states duties and time limits, and a seat layer for the applicant or recipient of income support, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
